note: Every Vial is an author-hosted project. Osmograph fetches the manifest from its raw URL, verifies the pinned manifest and UI hashes, and runs the same local policy gate as a file import. The review route verifies every declared fixture hash before it pins a reviewed entry. This index also carries author-hosted v2 Vials without an evidence block; those are labeled Ungated and are not reviewed listings. The host still verifies the bytes and owns every safety refusal on install. Legacy /1 entries are labeled and install as Ungated.

vials.name: Coffee Roast Log
vials.author: @example-author
vials.tagline: Track the roast, not just the aroma.
vials.summary: A reference manifest for testing URL install and the local policy gate. It is a template for authors building their own roasting workspace.
vials.install: Paste the manifest URL into Osmograph → Vials → Aromatory → Install from URL.

vials.name: Fermentation Lab
vials.author: @praisejamesx
vials.tagline: Track the batch, not just the bubble.
vials.summary: A batch log for home fermentation. The Vial's declared profile is the host detector: at least two channels must corroborate, persistence and hysteresis apply, and the array phase is compared to the logged pH, gravity, and temperature. Safety stays on the primary controls.
vials.install: Install from source above, or paste the manifest URL in Osmograph → Vials → Aromatory.

vials.name: Plant Respiration
vials.author: @praisejamesx
vials.tagline: Watch the plant, not just the number.
vials.summary: A one-plant change monitor. The Vial's declared profile is the host detector: at least two channels must corroborate, persistence and hysteresis apply, and the call is withheld when the enclosure moved. The workspace keeps a same-time-of-day session history.
vials.install: Install from source above, or paste the manifest URL in Osmograph → Vials → Aromatory.
